title: EOIR and USCIS issue communicable-disease security bars to asylum and withholding eligibility
agencies_affected: ["Customs and Border Protection", "U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services", "Unspecified/Other", "Executive Office for Immigration Review"]
snippet: EOIR and USCIS issue final rule adding public health-related bars to asylum eligibility. EOIR will also reject all NTAs with facially incorrect dates (i.e., falling on a holiday, weekend, or date or time when the assigned court is not open). If an NTA is not filed with the immigration court in time for the date and time of the hearing it references, EOIR will classify that case as a "failure to prosecute."
